law.catch_line: Investment of amounts allocated to separate accounts for variable life insurance and variable annuities
law.text: The amounts allocated to separate accounts for variable life insurance and variable annuities, pursuant to the provisions of § 38.2-3113, and accumulations on them, may be invested and reinvested by a domestic insurer in any type of Category 1 investment. Any percentage limitations based on the insurer's total admitted assets or surplus to policyholders shall not apply to investments made pursuant to this section.
